short_leg_sign_convention: short_sale_gross_return is positive when the sold-short bottom leg falls

limitations.market_beta: 12-month monthly-return beta is used; daily beta was not added as a new predictor.
limitations.benchmark_weights: Historical index constituent weights are absent; the eligible monthly pool is the exposure reference.
limitations.market_impact: The square-root cost term is a liquidity stratification proxy, not a calibrated impact model.
limitations.shorting: Borrow availability, borrow fees and short-sale execution are absent; short legs remain diagnostic.
